Indicator 11 measures the proportion of adult ADHD treatment courses that include pharmacological treatment across Danish regions and specific psychiatric departments [^src1]. The national average for this indicator stands at 70% [^src1]. Because the available data consists of a single snapshot from 2024, no longitudinal trends can be established, and the analysis is limited to cross-sectional comparisons [^src1].

At the regional level, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] leads with an 85% proportion, followed closely by [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 81% and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 80% [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] sits just below the national average at 67% [^src1]. In stark contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] acts as a significant outlier and trailer, recording only 37%, which is nearly half the national average [^src1]. [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] (private hospitals) show a high proportion of 90%, though this is based on a very small sample size of 10 patients [^src1].

When examining specific departments, several units achieved a 100% proportion of pharmacological treatment. Notably, [[ps-almenpsykiatrisk-syd-ambulatorier|PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier]] achieved this with a robust denominator of 20 patients [^src1]. Other departments reaching 100% include PMI Klinik for depression og mani - Midt (5/5), Carelink Psykiatri Kolding (3/3), and PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium in Aabenraa (3/3), alongside several units with suppressed denominators [^src1]. [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] also performs strongly with 86% (128/148), and [[rpg-psykiatrisk-klinik-1-godstrup|RPG Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 – Gødstrup]] reports 82% (201/246) [^src1].

Conversely, the lowest scores are found in specific specialized clinics and wards. [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik]] is a major outlier at the bottom, with only 21% of treatment courses involving pharmacological treatment [^src1]. Several departments, including Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R, PVO Psykiatrisk Afd. 25.0, PSY Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk ambulatorium (Odense), PHO Sengeafsnit Regionspsykiatri Horsens, and PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Sengeafsnit, reported 0%, though many of these have suppressed or very low patient counts [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af voksne ADHD-behandlingsforløb med farmakologisk behandling (Indikator 11) på tværs af regioner og specifikke afdelinger, og viser en bred spændvidde fra 0 % til 100 %, med Region Nordjylland og flere afdelinger i Midtjylland og Sjælland i top, mens Region Hovedstaden og nogle psykoterapeutiske klinikker ligger langt lavere.
